name: ScriptGenerationAgent
description: Generates one TypeScript Playwright .spec.ts file per business scenario. The LLM returns a validated JSON action-plan (fixed action verbs + named locator_map.json keys + reusable flows.json entries, never raw Playwright code), which a deterministic renderer turns into the .spec.ts file. Locators are merge-written from dom_elements.json into one project-wide locator_map.json (never deleted/duplicated on rescan), backing generated Page-factory classes (pages.ts) that are the actual automation surface at test-run time. Per-scenario tiered fallback and module setup-step injection. Positive-test count scales with SemanticMapAgent's functional clusters; negative/boundary counts stay a hard project.yaml-configured ceiling, filled by highest-confidence intent first. Phase 0: tests with destructive steps (unless allowed on non-prod) or navigation outside safety.allowed_hosts are dropped whole and reported before rendering; no localhost base-URL fallback, each new spec pins its module URL with test.use({baseURL}); test_plans.json / test_suite.json are written as schema_version 2 documents. Phase 1 (requirements.enabled): every plan test gets a stable tc_id, ac_ids (direct / similarity / inherited from its scenario), req_ids and priority; specs carry Playwright tags and annotations on the test( line (@P1 @negative @REQ-01 @AC-01.2; ac/tc/scenario annotations) with the primary AC id prefixing the title; dropped tests are recorded in test_plans.json dropped_tests[]; traceability.json is rebuilt after every run. Phase 2: live locator validation uses the shared resolver (tools/test_creation/script_generator/locator_resolve.py) and understands frame / scope entries from deep discovery.

inputs.name: requirements
inputs.description: Resolved requirements block; tracing is active when enabled and requirements.json exists

inputs.name: comprehension/business_scenarios.json
inputs.description: Scenarios to generate scripts for — MissingInputError if absent

inputs.name: test_creation/scenario_element_map.json
inputs.description: SemanticMapAgent output — relevant_elements (+ intent_id/action/expected_result/cluster/confidence when available); {} is tolerated but yields much thinner scripts

inputs.name: test_creation/test_data/test_data.json
inputs.description: Per-scenario positive/negative/boundary variants, keyed by scenario_id — a drift warning logs if none of its ids match current business_scenarios.json

inputs.name: test_creation/flows.json
inputs.description: Reusable named flows (e.g. login) the plan can reference via useFlow

inputs.name: safety
inputs.description: Resolved SafetyPolicy from project.yaml (environment + safety block); loaded from project.yaml when absent

outputs.name: traceability_json
outputs.description: test_creation/traceability.json — AC ↔ test case ↔ spec/title ↔ latest result (requirements.enabled only)

outputs.name: scripts_generated
outputs.description: Number of .spec.ts files written this run

outputs.name: test_suite_path
outputs.description: test_creation/test_suite.json — each spec entry now carries generation_mode

outputs.name: locator_map_path
outputs.description: test_creation/locator_map.json — merge-written from dom_elements.json every run

outputs.name: pages_path
outputs.description: test_creation/pages.ts — every module's Page-factory class + PAGE_REGISTRY

outputs.name: flows_path
outputs.description: test_creation/flows.generated.ts — rebuilt from flows.json when present

outputs.name: test_plans_path
outputs.description: test_creation/test_plans.json — validated JSON plan per scenario (tier 0/1 only)

outputs.name: test_plans.json dropped_for_safety
outputs.description: Per scenario: tests removed by the safety rails, with reason, rule and step
